title: RECON: Reasoning with Condensation for Efficient Retrieval-Augmented Generation
authors: Zhichao Xu; Minheng Wang; Yawei Wang; Wenqian Ye; Yuntao Du; Yunpu Ma; Yijun Tian
why_relevant: RECON addresses noisy/verbose retrieved documents by introducing a learned summarizer that condenses evidence within an RL-based agentic RAG loop, mitigating context dilution and noise that degrade RAG performance.
why_not_or_caveat: Primary focus is efficiency and accuracy via compression rather than robustness analysis, conflict, or adversarial settings.
